meta.naming: The paper says LiveLab; the public name is FastRSI.
meta.source_convention: repo paths are relative to the repo root at origin/main, with line numbers; 'atom:<id>' is a paper atom; 'PR #N' is a hao-ai-lab/fastrsi pull request description.

status_values.merged_gpu_verified: on main, and a GPU run of it is recorded (kb file or PR description)
status_values.merged_cpu_only: on main, tested on CPU only; no GPU run recorded
status_values.measured_not_in_repo: a measurement exists (paper atom or earlier tree) but no module for it is on main
status_values.planned: named in the docs as not built / not yet

shared_kernel.what: All three labs use one transaction kernel (core/livelab/kernel): locate, swap, journal, witness, findings, two-phase coordinator, session.

mechanisms.name: Live code swap (transaction kernel + vLLM adapter)
mechanisms.what: Replaces changed function bodies on every worker rank and in the engine core between the same two engine steps, with an undo journal and a witness that the new code ran.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: The whole restart (imports, weight load, profile run, JIT warm-up, CUDA graph capture).

measured_saving.setup: GB200, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8, TP1 and TP2, eager and CUDA graphs, 2026-11-06/07

mechanisms.note: PR #136 GPU receipt (B200, Qwen3-8B, TP=2): edit to committed 0.187 s, edit to first execution 0.190 s. Data parallel > 1 is refused (repos/vllm/livelab/adapter/README.md).

mechanisms.name: Triton kernel rebuild in place
mechanisms.what: Rebuilds an edited @triton.jit kernel inside the running process and counts its launches as the witness, instead of restarting to recompile it.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Process restart for a GPU-kernel edit.

measured_saving.setup: 1x B200, vLLM 0.33.0, Qwen3-8B, eager; baseline is a warm model load

mechanisms.note: Install 78-80 ms. repos/vllm/docs/architecture.md:99-100 also records 0.07 s vs a 61.5 s restart. PR #136 re-verified the launch witness at TP=2 (1692/1692).

mechanisms.name: Selective CUDA graph recapture
mechanisms.what: After a commit, recaptures only the CUDA graphs the edit touches, in the same step gap, and keeps the old graphs for an instant undo.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Full CUDA graph capture at start-up (and the restart around it).

measured_saving.setup: 1x B200, Qwen3-8B TP1, 166 graphs; 1-bucket recapture 0.369 s; full 166-graph recapture 5.48-6.09 s; undo 1.2-2 ms

mechanisms.note: Verified at TP1 only. TP>1, GB200 and the V2 model runner are listed as not verified. PR #144 (open) fixes recapture_extend keeping TP ranks in step.

mechanisms.name: Zygote (fork server) with module refresh
mechanisms.what: Imports vLLM and its libraries once, then forks each `vllm serve` from that state; modules edited since are re-imported in the fork.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Python and library imports (8,631 modules, 12.7 s).

measured_saving.setup: 1x B200, Qwen3-8B TP1 eager, launch to /health, 2026-11-06; leaf edit 10.2 s, core edit 12.4-13.7 s

mechanisms.name: Weight holder over CUDA IPC (`weights.py`, `vllm preload` daemon)
mechanisms.what: A daemon keeps the processed weights on the GPU; a restarted engine maps them instead of reading the checkpoint.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Weight load from disk.

measured_saving.setup: load_model step, 1x GB200, Qwen3-8B TP1 eager, 2026-11-07; time to healthy 51.85 -> 46.80 s

mechanisms.note: Not verified at TP>1 or in graph mode.

mechanisms.name: KV-cache plan reuse (`kvplan.py`)
mechanisms.what: Saves the measured KV-cache memory plan and restores it on the next start, skipping the profiling forward pass.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: The memory-profile run that sizes the KV cache.

measured_saving.setup: 1x GB200, Qwen3-8B TP1 eager; time to healthy 51.85 -> 43.97 s; cold cache root profile run 62.27 s (PR #30)

mechanisms.name: Launcher with all three holders (zygote + IPC weights + KV plan)
mechanisms.what: One CLI (`engine.py start`) that starts a server from the zygote with resident weights and a reused KV plan.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Imports, weight read and profile run together.

measured_saving.setup: 1x GB200, Qwen3-8B TP1 eager, 2026-11-07; 7.0x; greedy output bit-identical

mechanisms.name: Weight lease, NCCL seeder and standby pool
mechanisms.what: K engines on a GPU share one weight copy; a holder on another GPU is filled by an NCCL copy instead of a checkpoint read; a router fails over to a standby engine.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Weight read and per-engine weight memory; recovery time after a crash or a bad patch.

measured_saving.setup: weight attach, 1 node of B200 GPUs, Qwen3-8B TP1, vLLM 0.33.0 fork; MoE model 12.87 -> 2.10 s; engine weight memory 15.27 GiB -> 0.0 GiB

mechanisms.note: The PR says plainly that start-up savings are small: time to healthy 32.31 -> 29.80 s. Other numbers: NCCL seed 31.5 ms for 16.4 GB; failover 29.8-66.1 ms from fault to first token (Qwen3-8B). Weight patches only; TP>1, EP and cross-node not run. Replaces the PR #125 version, which was a simulation.

mechanisms.name: Live reconfigure of scheduler limits
mechanisms.what: Changes `max_num_seqs` (and `max_num_batched_tokens`) in the running engine between two steps and reads the value back before recording it.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: A restart to change a launch flag.

measured_saving.after: 0.0022 (round trip; 0.027 ms in the engine loop)
measured_saving.setup: B200, vLLM 0.15.1, Qwen3-8B, `--max-num-seqs 4`

mechanisms.note: Only `max_num_seqs` was changed live on GPU. `max_num_batched_tokens` is implemented but not run on GPU. Every other flag restarts the engine. The tier latencies in repos/vllm/kb/reconfiguration_matrix.md are targets, not measurements.

mechanisms.name: KV-cache snapshot and replay
mechanisms.what: Saves the KV blocks and RNG state of a running batch per KV-cache group and restores them, so the same steps can be replayed.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Re-prefilling a long context before each candidate step.

measured_saving.setup: B200, gemma-3-1b-it (7 KV groups), 3.41 MB snapshot; 16/16 replayed steps token-identical

mechanisms.note: No before/after start-up saving is recorded. The module is quarantined: it covers the model runner only and nothing in the measured path uses it. PR #129 (the original) was CPU-only.

mechanisms.name: Parallelism resharder (TP/DP/EP)
mechanisms.what: Re-slices resident weights for a new tensor-, data- or expert-parallel layout without reading the checkpoint.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Weight reload when the parallel layout changes.
mechanisms.note: CPU tensor tests only; no GPU collective was run. PR #148 (open) adds a MoE reshard refusal.

mechanisms.name: Fork-safety guards, NUMA affinity and thread clamping (`core/livelab/forksafe.py`)
mechanisms.what: Answers import-time GPU queries from NVML so the zygote never initializes CUDA, binds forked workers to their GPU's CPU socket and clamps thread pools.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Lets a fork server exist at all; no direct start-up saving recorded.
mechanisms.note: PR #128 records no GPU overhead numbers. The no-CUDA-in-zygote guard itself is exercised by every GPU zygote run above.

mechanisms.name: Autotune config reuse
mechanisms.what: Reuse the kernel autotuner's saved configuration instead of re-tuning at start.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Kernel autotune at start-up.

measured_saving.setup: one-line scheduler edit check on 1 GB200, warm on-disk caches (earlier measurement)

mechanisms.note: A row of the earlier cost ladder; no module on main implements it. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4, autotune took 627.2 s warm and was re-run despite saved configs (repos/vllm/kb/costs.md:33-37).

mechanisms.name: Keep CUDA graphs across a check
mechanisms.what: Keep captured CUDA graphs instead of recapturing them.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: CUDA graph capture.

measured_saving.setup: same earlier ladder, 1 GB200

mechanisms.note: Ladder row from the earlier measurement. On main the equivalent is the live process plus selective recapture.

mechanisms.name: Component restart (worker group, engine core, API server)
mechanisms.what: Restart only the process that owns the invalidated state, against holders that outlive it.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Most of a warm engine restart.
mechanisms.note: Not built; its 2-10 s cost is an estimate.

mechanisms.name: KV memory holder
mechanisms.what: A holder process that owns the KV pool so an engine-core restart keeps the prefix cache.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: KV allocation and re-prefill.

mechanisms.name: Live swap in the train-step gap
mechanisms.what: Replaces changed function bodies on every rank in the gap before a train step, through one gloo round per kernel call.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: The whole restart: imports, init, kernel warm-up and the slow first train step.

measured_saving.before: 57.5 (tiny) / 59.8 (14B), process start to first step done
measured_saving.setup: GB200, TP 2, megatron-core 0.20 dev, 2026-11-07

mechanisms.note: Covers function bodies and repair cells. Not yet: torch.compile (`jit_fuser`) functions, CUDA graph regions, constructors, optimizer construction, Transformer Engine C++ (repos/megatron/livelab/README.md:59-61).

mechanisms.name: Start-state snapshot and restore
mechanisms.what: Keeps a code-independent start state (weights, Adam state, scheduler, RNG, frozen batches) in pinned host memory and restores it before every check.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Re-initializing the job to get a comparable starting point.

measured_saving.setup: restore of 96.3 GiB per rank, Qwen3-14B architecture TP 2, GB200; 1.9 s on 2x B200 (PR #138); 0.79 s for 106.8 GiB at 32B TP 4

mechanisms.note: No 'before' number is recorded for this step alone; the alternative is a restart.

mechanisms.name: Zygote (rank fork server)
mechanisms.what: One process per node holds torch, Transformer Engine and Megatron imported with CUDA untouched; a restart forks the ranks from it.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Interpreter start and imports (10-52 s per torchrun start).

measured_saving.setup: request to first train step done, 4x GB200, env on network file system vs zygote, 2026-11-07; 15.0-16.5 / 22.8-25.1 s with Dynamo and Inductor preloaded

mechanisms.note: Forked ranks ran 2-11% slower in steady state than torchrun ranks, cause not found; the README says to use torchrun for throughput and the zygote for loss and correctness checks (repos/megatron/livelab/README.md:160-167).

mechanisms.name: Node-local environment (`tools/stage_local.sh`)
mechanisms.what: Copies the Python environment, Megatron and the compile caches to the node's RAM disk so imports do not read a network file system.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Import time from a network file system.

measured_saving.setup: 4x GB200; staging costs 161-247 s once per node

mechanisms.name: Code restart from the zygote (import overlay)
mechanisms.what: For an edit the live swap refuses, forks from the zygote and re-imports only `megatron` with the edited modules.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Re-importing torch and Transformer Engine on a code restart.

measured_saving.setup: upstream PR NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#7575, request to lab ready; megatron re-import 1.4 s

mechanisms.note: One other run took 148.7 s (kernel warm-up 65.8 s instead of 4-5 s), not explained.

mechanisms.name: Zygote supervision and fail-closed reset
mechanisms.what: The zygote reaps its ranks, ranks die with the zygote, a gone client cannot kill the lab, and `reset` refuses when the state keys do not match.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Stuck GPUs and manual clean-up after a fault; no start-up saving.
mechanisms.note: 30-check GPU driver on 2x B200, all pass: reset 1.9 s, install about 0.05 s, loss bit-identical after faults.

mechanisms.name: Thread clamping and GC freeze in the zygote
mechanisms.what: Clamps OMP and compile threads to 1 and freezes the garbage-collector heap before forking.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Extra threads per forked rank (31 fewer).
mechanisms.note: The steady-state step-time confirmation on GPU is listed as not verified.

mechanisms.name: Launch tricks for Megatron-Bridge (nvcc cache, stash pre-allocation, 1 graph warm-up step)
mechanisms.what: Three start-up changes for the full-model two-tray recipe.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Compile and warm-up time at launch.

mechanisms.name: In-place rebuild (`services/rebuild.py`)
mechanisms.what: Re-imports edited modules in the warm worker and rebuilds the objects made from them, keeping the process, CUDA context and weights; for constructors, new fields and module constants.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Worker respawn for edits the live swap refuses.

measured_saving.setup: GB200, 2026-11-07; +2.8-3.2 s when per-layer CUDA graphs must be re-captured

mechanisms.note: PR #146 (open) makes the rebuild atomic and fixes live swaps on the rebuilt base.

mechanisms.name: Zygote respawn (`services/zygote.py`)
mechanisms.what: Forks new workers from a server that already imported FastVideo (357 modules), without touching CUDA.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Worker interpreter start and imports (17-20 s).

measured_saving.setup: GB200, paired runs, 2026-11-07

mechanisms.name: Weights holder (`services/holder.py`)
mechanisms.what: A holder process keeps the DiT, text encoder and VAE on the GPU; respawned workers map them by CUDA IPC, and the holder refuses when loader or model code changed.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Component loads from disk (10.9 s of a zygote respawn).

measured_saving.setup: 1 GB200; DiT: 1,838 tensors (36.9 GiB) mapped in 0.12 s; 13.56-14.56 s at 2 ranks with DiT and text encoder only

mechanisms.note: The audio VAE cannot be shared (a non-leaf tensor that requires grad) and is loaded by the worker (0.9 s).

mechanisms.name: Path-stable JIT caches (`services/jitcache.py`)
mechanisms.what: Keeps the FlashInfer, Triton and Inductor cache roots at the path they were built at, presets Inductor's `torch_key`, and turns on Triton's autotune cache.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: JIT rebuild and autotune in a fresh process.

measured_saving.setup: per-process JIT in the first video, 1 GB200; avoids a 153-159 s FlashInfer rebuild when a cache root is moved; Triton autotune 1.94-2.64 s gone

mechanisms.note: A fresh process still pays 17-38 s of imports and 30-35 s of loads.

mechanisms.name: Release of old captured state on rebuild (`rebuild.release_held`)
mechanisms.what: Frees CUDA graphs and static buffers held by replaced modules before the new code captures its own.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Out-of-memory after a rebuild (a correctness guard, not a time saving).
mechanisms.note: Each of 4 rebuilds released 100 CUDA graphs and 62.3 GiB of static buffers; every video bit-exact.

mechanisms.name: Edits inside torch.compile regions, Triton kernel bodies in place, VAE decoder CUDA graphs, native kernels
mechanisms.what: Live install of these edit kinds in the FastVideo lab.
mechanisms.startup_cost_removed: Restart or respawn for those edits.
mechanisms.note: Listed as not covered / not shown.
